purpose: Binds the U5 m.16270 ancestral-conflict guard to the source-audited Build 17 registry and the immutable implementation state immediately before this evidence-only packet.

license_or_terms.handling: Only a minimal public provenance extract and source digest are retained; this packet does not assert a reuse licence.

u5_guard.markerless_reason: C16270T is callable only in pgp_4187 and pgp_huA08F4D; emitting it would block valid U5 descendants in pgp_4139 and pgp_4162.

runtime_decision.ancestral_c: withhold U5 and descendant traversal; report the emitted parent U
runtime_decision.unambiguous_derived_t: permit traversal only; do not assign U5 from this marker
runtime_decision.merged_flag_only_ambiguity_sentinel: withhold U5 and descendant traversal; a merged sample collapses a discordant locus to one sentinel row, so the conflict must not be read as missing data

known_false_veto.effect: a genuine U5 carrier typed as ancestral C is reported as U
known_false_veto.accepted_because: the failure direction is loss of resolution, never a positive misassignment
known_false_veto.rate_note: No retained source quantifies how often this occurs; this packet asserts no rate.
